ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - GMER Rootkit Detector and Remover Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution GMER tool based on image and hash fields.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\gmer\\\.exe$") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=E9DC058440D321AA17D0600B3CA0AB04.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=539C228B6B332F5AA523E5CE358C16647D8BBE57.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=E8A3E804A96C716A3E9B69195DB6FFB0D33E2433AF871E4D4E1EAB3097237173.*")))
